description: Update the conformance testing system to save each formatting difference as a separate snapshot file rather than aggregating them into a single file. This will make it easier for developers and AI tools to review specific formatting changes by isolating individual diffs.
functional_requirements: Modify the conformance test runner to generate separate snapshot files for each test case that produces formatting differences
Organize diff snapshots in a hierarchical directory structure that mirrors the test file organization
Update the snapshot comparison logic to read from individual diff files instead of a consolidated snapshot file
Ensure the system properly cleans up or updates individual diff files when tests are updated or removed
